races.display_title: Percy's Racing Dream Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: EVALUATION certainly comes with risks attached, but he looked to be crying out for this longer trip when running well in stronger events last year, so he's awarded the vote. Course specialist Heart Above has to be high on the shortlist, while Ballynoe Boy will be of firm interest if taking up this engagement after getting a hat-trick up at Hexham on Friday. EVALUATION HEART ABOVE BALLYNOE BOY (IRE)

races.verdict: A case can be made for a few of these but TROPICAL TALENT looked the likely winner until hitting the last at Sedgefield last time and is weighted to make amends here. TROPICAL TALENT HOLY LEGEND PLAYFUL FOX (FR)

races.display_title: Seamus Weldon John Deere Dealer Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict: COLIN’S FRIEND improved in a competitive handicap on stable debut at Galway last time and, with further progress likely, he looks worth chancing in an ordinary affair. The Border Boy is well treated at present and looked set to go close when making a last-flight error here last month, so rates the main danger, while Granlahan and Kingdom Calling are also respected. COLIN'S FRIEND (IRE) THE BORDER BOY (IRE) GRANLAHAN (IRE)

races.display_title: Carry Out Handicap Chase
races.verdict: STONEYFORD LADY looked a big threat when unseating her rider at Ballinrobe last month so Henry de Bromhead's mare gets the nod to make amends provided she's none the worse from that spill. Kilbrin Rocco shaped well from his lower hurdling mark at Listowel recently and if translating that form back to chasing, he looks a big threat with Jack Kennedy booked. The frustrating Presenting Lad looks best of the rest. STONEYFORD LADY (IRE) KILBRIN ROCCO (IRE) PRESENTING LAD (IRE)
